title: Nonparametric inference for density-dependent McKean--Vlasov diffusions
summary: The present research is devoted to the nonparametric estimation of a density-dependent drift coefficient in a multivariate McKean--Vlasov diffusion from independent observations at a common time, as well as the stationary density. Under certain assumptions on the (known) potential, we reduce the problem to the one-dimensional one and construct a sieve maximum-likelihood estimator based on sparse ReQU neural networks subject to structural and Hölder constraints.
